semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in semiconductor reliability testing and power supply solutions.
summary: Zhejiang Hangke Instrument Co., Ltd. is a high-end equipment manufacturer focused on providing testing solutions for semiconductor reliability and power supply systems. They offer a range of testing equipment, including burn-in systems and IGBT power cycle test systems, designed to ensure the performance and reliability of electronic components.
capabilities: IGBT power cycle test system PC3000A
Large scale integrated circuit burn-in test system

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in Hangzhou, China, and focuses on the domestic and international semiconductor testing market.
